meta.title: Cartogram studio
meta.note: State outlines are projected and simplified by mapshaper, once. Everything numerical -- scaling, placement, relaxation, sampling, balancing, cells, assignment -- is recomputed in the browser by web/solver.js.
meta.caveat: Cells here are the raw convex ones, clipped by the browser at paint time with an SVG clipPath rather than by mapshaper. Identical on screen; not true clipped geometry. Exact areas and exported files come from the R build.
